label: prop:magic-A-binding-formula
title: Doubly-magic light-nucleus binding formula: $\mathfrak{B}(^A_Z\mathfrak{X}) = \rho_F \cdot \mathfrak{m}_e \cdot A \cdot 8G$
html:
Proposition. Doubly-magic light-nucleus binding formula: \mathfrak{B}(^A_Z\mathfrak{X}) = \rho_F \cdot \mathfrak{m}_e \cdot A \cdot 8G

Theorem (conditional on conj:magic-numbers-bring, prop:gravity-spectral-prefactor, and conj:diagrammatic-double-magic-lr-fusion). For a light nucleus ^A_Z\mathfrak{X} that is doubly magic (both Z \in \mathfrak{M} and N \in \mathfrak{M}, with \mathfrak{M} = \{2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126\}), the binding energy admits the closed form

  \mathfrak{B}(^A_Z\mathfrak{X}) \;=\; \rho_F \cdot \mathfrak{m}_e \cdot A \cdot 8G

where G is Catalan's constant, 8G = \mathrm{Vol}(L6a4) = \mathrm{Vol}(\mathrm{Borromean}) is the universal residue prefactor (prop:gravity-spectral-prefactor), and \rho_F \in \mathbb{R} is the substrate-determined structural prefactor for the doubly-magic regime.

Specialised to ^4_2\mathrm{He} with \rho_F = 2:

  \mathfrak{B}(^4_2\mathrm{He})
    \;=\; 2 \cdot \mathfrak{m}_e \cdot 4 \cdot 8G
    \;\approx\; 29.956\;\mathrm{MeV}

compared to the experimental value 28.296\,\mathrm{MeV} — a relative miss of +5.9\%. This is dramatically tighter than the alpha-shift formula (prop:binding-alpha-shift-extension) which misses ^4_2\mathrm{He} by -79\% (5\times too small) because that formula assumes a single hyperbolic force-carrier knot per nucleus — an assumption that breaks for doubly-magic nuclei.

The regime necessity, the derivation of the \rho_F prefactor, and the comparison witness are collected in the doubly-magic binding context.

Status (owner ruling, 2026-09-05): retired as a knot-selection route. Its atom-to-knot assignments are chosen from a census so the knot's volume reproduces B_AME/m_e — the A ∈ {5,6,7} gap exists precisely because no census knot has the right volume — and the ^4He "magic" rule is 4\times the ^3He prediction using the same \mathrm{Vol}(L6a4) = 8G, so it is not an independent confirmation. Kept for the record, not as a live binding route. See docs/audits/2026-09-05-binding-route-consolidation-no-knot-selection.md.
